description: Return the Markdown source of one documentation page, addressed by an id from search_knowledge or list_knowledge. The first line is the page's URL, for citation. Long pages come back as a heading outline instead; pass section to read one part of them.

id.description: page identifier exactly as returned by search_knowledge or list_knowledge, for example docs:sdk/quickstart.md

section.description: return only this section of the page, matched case-insensitively against its level-two headings

name: fetch_knowledge
title: Read a Tailor Platform documentation page
